design_question: Does free access to office applications improve self-directed deduction without obscuring the current work objective?

context.build: Design only; no playable build or observed sessions exist.
context.player_context: Chinese-language desktop browser players with varying office software familiarity.
evidence: The user explicitly rejected a document-led story outline and requested an explorable working desktop.
Official game descriptions establish comparable mechanics, not evidence that this proposed combination works.
All expected player experiences remain designer assumptions without behavioral validation.
context.decision: Choose free initial application access or sequential access for the first playable workday.

desired_experience.statement: Players understand their work objective while choosing their own evidence discovery and verification paths.
observable_signals: Players explain both the current assignment and the question they are investigating.
Players identify the operation and evidence that changed their interpretation.
Different players use different valid discovery orders.

lens.name: decision structure
lens.why: The variable changes available operations and discovery choices while preserving evidence and consequences.
lens.limitations: This lens cannot establish atmosphere, character appeal or enjoyment without observation.

causal_chain.mechanic: Office applications are accessible initially, with multiple logical routes to required materials.
causal_chain.interaction: Players alternate between work, optional activities, browsing files and asking colleagues.
causal_chain.dynamic: Evidence discovery follows player questions rather than a fixed application sequence.
causal_chain.perceived_signal: Actual document submissions and questions receive content-dependent responses.
causal_chain.experience: Self-directed deduction with a legible work objective.
causal_chain.assumption: Free access may instead cause confusion; both effective exploration and perceived agency are unverified.
causal_chain.evidence: User preference supports the intended experience, but no playtest supports these causal arrows.

hypotheses.claim: Free application access supports varied valid investigation paths without harming objective comprehension.
hypotheses.change: Replace sequential application availability with free availability at the start.
hypotheses.expected_signal: Players explain the same evidence conflict after reaching it through different application sequences.
hypotheses.falsifier: The free variant mainly increases aimless switching or dependence on hints; alternatively sequential access feels equally autonomous and clearer.
hypotheses.competing_explanation: Navigation clarity, office familiarity, reading load or prior exposure could account for differences.
hypotheses.unchanged: Assignment, files, answers, application functions, text, feedback rules, device and necessary clues.

prototype.control: One promotion-report assignment with applications made available sequentially.
prototype.variant: The identical assignment with all main applications accessible initially.
prototype.scope: One workday and one cross-application reporting discrepancy; no complete story or fatal endings.
prototype.risks: Repeated exposure teaches the answer; office familiarity and navigation barriers may confound comparison.

evidence_plan.participants_context: Record Chinese target players office and desktop mystery familiarity, input devices and accessibility needs; determine sufficiency from decision risk.
observations: Objective and investigation-question explanations at natural pauses.
Reasons for application changes and evidence selection.
Whether new evidence leads players to revise an interpretation.
behavioral_measures: Application access sequences and submitted work contents.
Clue entry routes, assistance requests and repeated aimless switching.
qualitative_prompts: Which operation changed your understanding, and why?
When were you unsure what to do, and what was missing?
What determined the order of your investigation?
evidence_plan.decision_rule: Keep free access only when objective comprehension and evidence reasoning remain intact and behavior plus interviews support agency. Revise navigation barriers first; report inconclusive results honestly. Time spent alone is not success.
integrity_checks: Verify application access matches the assigned variant.
Keep content, answers and feedback identical.
Record prior exposure, order, familiarity, devices and accessibility barriers.
Retain contradictory accounts and minority barriers rather than averaging them away.

ethics.dark_patterns: No real-time countdown, sudden lethal punishment for exploring, spending pressure or automatic notification subscription.
ethics.accessibility: Critical audio has equivalent text; operations support keyboard navigation and explicit field explanations.
ethics.privacy: Use fictional files and accounts only; obtain consent for session records and never request real documents or contacts.

decisions.decision: Build a small comparison before expanding the story.
decisions.basis: The intended experience is explicit, but guidance needs and open-exploration effects remain untested.

route_out.next_owner: Desktop prototype implementation and playtest research
route_out.reason: Evidence decision is inconclusive pending observed behavior and player explanations.
